Water bowls and a plain notice
The desk is glad to help late last night
Travelers with companion animals must check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.

Pet travel must be arranged in advance so staff can review comfort needs, carrier fit, feeding plans, and any welfare concerns. The desk gives clear guidance, checks documents, and helps travelers avoid delays at the gate. Every animal is handled by trained staff who keep the process calm and orderly.

Please bring the animal in a secure carrier unless staff have approved another method. Keep the carrier clean, well ventilated, and marked with the traveler's details. If the animal shows signs of stress, report this at once so the welfare coordinator can assess the situation and advise on the safest next step. Follow all instructions from Aurelia Skyways staff without delay.

For practical support, stay near the desk until your case is complete. Companion Animal Travel Desk
